title_zh: 科举考试与一首诗的命运
title_en: Great Poems and Songs (11/20): The Imperial Exam and the Fate of a Poem
note_en: 才 before a verb means "only then" or "only if": 读书人通过考试才能当官 "scholars could become officials only by passing the exam." English puts "only" next to the condition, but Chinese states the condition first and puts 才 right before the verb, as again in 诗写得好，才算真正有学问.
